name: SalesFlow Pro CRM
description: A modern, full-featured CRM system built with React and FastAPI

SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for JWT token generation. Generate using: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"

ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES.description: JWT token expiration time in minutes

FRONTEND_URL.description: Frontend URL for CORS and OAuth redirects (e.g., https://your-app.herokuapp.com)

VITE_API_URL.description: Backend API URL for frontend (e.g., https://your-backend-app.herokuapp.com/)

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth Client ID from Google Cloud Console

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth Client Secret from Google Cloud Console

INTEGRATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32-byte encryption key for integration credentials. Generate using: python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"

SMTP_SECURE.description: Use SSL/TLS for SMTP (false for STARTTLS)

FROM_EMAIL.description: Email address to send emails from

STORAGE_BACKEND.description: Storage backend (local or azure_blob). Use azure_blob for production on Heroku.

AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME.description: Azure Storage Account name (required if STORAGE_BACKEND=azure_blob)

AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_KEY.description: Azure Storage Account key (required if STORAGE_BACKEND=azure_blob)

AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING.description: Azure Storage connection string (alternative to account name/key)

AZURE_BLOB_CONTAINER_NAME.description: Azure Blob container name for file storage

VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Gemini AI API key for AI features (optional)
